title: Concept Evidence (canonical)
description: Path-neutral knowledge contract for one concept_id: the facts that must be learned, the misconceptions that damage later learning, and which source backs each fact (playbook §6–7). Built once, stored in registry/concept_evidence_registry.json, reused by every path that teaches the same concept_id. Path-specific framing never lives here.

required_facts.description: The minimum complete set a learner must understand. Every assessment question later must trace back to one of these.

source_refs.description: Optional; same source_id[#locator] form as facts.

id.description: Scoped to this concept: f1, f2, ...

source_refs.description: source_id, optionally with a locator: source_id#section (e.g. openintro_statistics_textbook#1.2.1). The source_id must exist in the batch's source pack. A fact with no source is not a required fact — drop it or back it.
